leadText: Ganga Town (Japanese: ダンダタウン Danda Town) is the hometown of Gavin. It was mentioned in From Brags to Riches. It is unknown where it is located.
plainText:
Ganga Town (Japanese: ダンダタウン Danda Town) is the hometown of Gavin. It was mentioned in From Brags to Riches. It is unknown where it is located.

==Trivia==
The dub name of this location is similar to the Japanese name of Muscle Island, "Ganga Island".
